toc.title: The pairs the exam likes to confuse
Numbers and ports to know cold

html:
1The pairs the exam likes to confuse

Pair The difference
IDS / IPS alerts / blocks inline
NAS / SAN file-level / block-level
Scalability / elasticity can grow / grows and shrinks automatically
TCP / UDP reliable / fast and unreliable
AH / ESP authentication only / encryption too
RADIUS / TACACS+ network access, UDP / device administration, TCP, full encryption
Site-to-site / client-to-site VPN office to office / user to office
Full / split tunnel all traffic in the VPN / only company traffic
RPO / RTO acceptable data loss / acceptable downtime
Cold / warm / hot site shell / equipment, old data / running, current data
Active-active / active-passive shared load / standby takes over
EOL / EOS no longer sold / no longer supported
Flow data / packet capture summaries / full contents
SNMPv2c / SNMPv3 community strings / authentication and encryption
DNSSEC / DoH proves authenticity / hides the query
Bandwidth / throughput capacity / data actually delivered
Latency / jitter delay / variation in delay

2Numbers and ports to know cold

Item Value
Ports SSH 22, Telnet 23, SMTP 25, DNS 53, DHCP 67/68, HTTP 80, NTP 123, SNMP 161/162, LDAP 389, HTTPS 443, SMB 445, RDP 3389
Private ranges 10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16; APIPA 169.254/16
Subnets /24 254, /25 126, /26 62, /27 30, /28 14, /29 6, /30 2
Channels at 2.4 GHz 1, 6, 11
Administrative distance static 1, EIGRP 90, OSPF 110, RIP 120
MTU 1500 standard, about 9000 jumbo

3The troubleshooting order

Identify, theory, test, plan, implement, verify, document.

Exam tip

. In a scenario, find the layer first (cable and link lights, switch and VLAN, IP and routing, transport and ports, application and DNS), then match the symptom to the tool or fix.

Exam tip

. Performance-based questions are scored. Read the whole task, do what is asked and nothing more, and check your work before moving on.

4Exam Q&A: final review

4.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1Which protocol encrypts remote administration of a switch on port 22?

  • ATelnet
  • BRDP
  • CSSH
  • DSNMPv2c
Show the answer

Answer: C. SSH uses port 22.

S2How many usable hosts does a /27 subnet provide?

  • A32
  • B62
  • C14
  • D30
Show the answer

Answer: D. A /27 has 32 addresses and 30 usable hosts.

S3A company can lose at most 4 hours of data. Which metric states this?

  • ARTO of 4 hours
  • BMTBF of 4 hours
  • CRPO of 4 hours
  • DMTTR of 4 hours
Show the answer

Answer: C. RPO is the acceptable data loss in time.

S4A host with a 169.254.x.x address cannot reach the network. What is the most likely cause?

  • AA wrong DNS record
  • BA duplicate MAC address
  • CA blocked port 443
  • DDHCP did not assign an address
Show the answer

Answer: D. APIPA addresses appear when DHCP fails.

S5Which first step does the troubleshooting methodology start with?

  • AImplement the solution
  • BIdentify the problem
  • CDocument the findings
  • DEstablish a plan of action
Show the answer

Answer: B. Gathering information about the problem comes first.

S6Which device alerts on suspicious traffic but does not block it?

  • AAn intrusion prevention system
  • BA stateful firewall
  • CAn intrusion detection system
  • DA web proxy
Show the answer

Answer: C. An IDS alerts; an IPS blocks.

S7Which command shows the routing table on a network device?

  • Ashow vlan
  • Bshow power
  • Cshow route
  • Dshow arp
Show the answer

Answer: C. show route displays the routing table.

S8A route to 10.1.5.0/24 and one to 10.1.0.0/16 both match. Which wins?

  • AThe /16, the largest network
  • BThe one with the lowest metric regardless of prefix
  • CThe /24, the longest prefix
  • DThe default route
Show the answer

Answer: C. The longest prefix match is chosen first.

S9Which attack fills a switch's MAC table so it floods frames out every port?

  • AMAC flooding
  • BARP poisoning
  • CVLAN hopping
  • DDNS poisoning
Show the answer

Answer: A. MAC flooding exhausts the table.

4.2 Recall questions

R1What is the passing score?

Show the answer

720 on a scale of 100 to 900.

R2What is the troubleshooting order?

Show the answer

Identify, theory, test, plan, implement, verify, document.

R3What are the five domains?

Show the answer

Concepts, implementation, operations, security and troubleshooting.

R4What does RADIUS authenticate?

Show the answer

Network access for users and devices.

R5Which port does HTTPS use?

Show the answer

443.

R6What does VLAN hopping bypass?

Show the answer

Network segmentation.
